headline: Multiple protocol contracts identified on Gnosis Chain (xDai); primary YAM exchange and governance infrastructure confirmed
short_headline: YAM + RealToken contracts on Gnosis Chain

findings.text: Gnosisscan name-tag search recovered YAM (Yam Proxy) contract at 0xc759aa7f9dd9720a1502c104dae4f9852bb17c14, SOON governance token at 0xaa2c0cf54cb418eb24e7e09053b82c875c68bb88, and multiple RealToken ERC-20 contracts for individual properties (e.g., 0x9d918ee39a356be8ef99734599c7e70160db4db6 for 12405-SANTA-ROSA property).

Official website realt.co exists but geo-blocks US visitors. FAQ/documentation at faq.realt.co confirms Gnosis Chain as primary deployment target with references to Ethereum as secondary option; no canonical deployments list page located.

No audit links provided in context and none discovered; protocol documentation references RMM v3 (Aave V2-based lending market) and bridge.realtoken.network as infrastructure but no security audit reports found.

Protocol.github entry is null/not recorded; source code verified on Gnosisscan at 0x3b9543e2851accaef9b4f6fb42fcaea5e9231589 (RealTokenYamUpgradeableV3) with Solidity v0.8.4 compilation but no direct GitHub repo link found.
Protocol operates only on xDai (Gnosis Chain) per context and discovered documentation. Ethereum sightings appear to be historical/legacy; primary activity now on Gnosis.

YAM contract at 0xc759aa7f9dd9720a1502c104dae4f9852bb17c14 functions as P2P trading venue, not a factory. Individual RealToken ERC-20 contracts (one per property) are deployed separately and whitelisted by admin; enumeration would require off-chain property list.

Admin roles identified: DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE (identical holder per RealTokenYamUpgradeableV3 initialize function); MODERATOR_ROLE for secondary admin duties. All roles assigned via AccessControl. No multisig or timelock detected in YAM contract.
All addresses traced to Gnosisscan fetches; no snippet-only sightings retained.

rationale.verdict: Discovered core YAM secondary-market contract, SOON governance token, and individual property token addresses on Gnosis Chain via Gnosisscan and on-chain code verification. Website blocks US visitors; no canonical deployed-addresses doc or GitHub repo identified. RMM and bridge infrastructure mentioned in docs but contract addresses not yet surfaced. Unable to enumerate all property tokens without off-chain data source.

evidence.shows: YAM secondary market proxy contract verified on Gnosis Chain; ERC1967Proxy pattern with implementation at 0x3b9543e2851accaef9b4f6fb42fcaea5e9231589; 553,151 transactions recorded.

RealTokenYamUpgradeableV3 implementation contract; AccessControl with DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, UPGRADER_ROLE, MODERATOR_ROLE; initialize() grants admin and upgrader to same address, moderator to separate address; UUPSUpgradeable pattern.

Official RealT FAQ confirms Gnosis Chain as primary deployment, xDai as transaction currency, YAM as secondary market, RMM v3 (Aave V2-based) for collateralization, and bridge.realtoken.network for Ethereum<->Gnosis transfers.
RealT Medium article (Aug 2024) confirms Gnosis Chain adoption, RMM weekly revenue distribution via armmWXDAI, abstract accounts, and $3.6M+ distributed through RMM since launch.
Request Finance case study documents RealT use of Gnosis Chain for USDC payouts and xDAI billing.
